% The LaTeX half of card.tex. The card class is the face class's card preset (tex/ltface.cls): one
% face per frame at the ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 trim inside a 5 mm safe margin, its lines on the grid; the
% fixture's face replaces the class's, so what differs is how each engine sets text on the face.
\documentclass[preset=card]{ltface}
\setmainfont{OpenSans-Regular.ttf}[Path=../corpus/fonts/, BoldFont=OpenSans-Bold.ttf, ItalicFont=OpenSans-Italic.ttf, BoldItalicFont=OpenSans-BoldItalic.ttf]
\setsansfont{OpenSans-Regular.ttf}[Path=../corpus/fonts/, BoldFont=OpenSans-Bold.ttf, ItalicFont=OpenSans-Italic.ttf, BoldItalicFont=OpenSans-BoldItalic.ttf]
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
Alder is the card's first line.

Birch is its second.

Cedar is its third.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
